page_title: UDI 2-3 ACM | Udinese v AC Milan 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Fabio Maresca is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Udinese.
90+5' Substitution. Yunus Musah (AC Milan) on for Rafael Leao.
90+3' 2 - 3 Goal! Olivier Giroud gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Noah Okafor (AC Milan), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 2:3.
90+3' The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
90+3' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but Maduka Okoye easily deals with the threat.
88' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' The resulting corner from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) comes to nothing.
87' The corner from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replaces Hassane Kamara.
83' 2 - 2 Luka Jovic (AC Milan) gets to the rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the right post and makes it 2:2.
83' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
82' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
79' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Lucca trots off the pitch and is replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Luka Jovic for Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
75' A substitution has been made. Davide Calabria is replaced by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan).
75' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.

74' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
71' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
71' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Tijjani Reijnders walks off the pitch to be replaced by Noah Okafor (AC Milan).

68' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the left side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Mike Maignan makes a comfortable save.
65' Walace (Udinese) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

62' 2 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Florian Thauvin (Udinese) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 2:1.
61' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to substitute Lazar Samardzic and he is replaced by Martin Payero (Udinese).
60' Substitution. Festy Ebosele makes his way off the pitch and Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) comes on as his replacement.
59' Maduka Okoye makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) after a cross from the side.
56' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
55' A pass by Sandi Lovric (Udinese) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' What was Festy Ebosele (Udinese) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
50' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) comes off for Florian Thauvin.
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
45+6' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Mike Maignan and he's equal to it.
45+2' AC Milan will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
45+1' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
42' 1 - 1 Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot into the bottom left corner. What a remarkable goal!
39' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
35' The match is interrupted due to racist chants.

32' 0 - 1 Goal! Theo Hernandez produces a great pass that finds Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
29' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mike Maignan intercepts the ball.
28' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' A mid-range free kick is awarded to AC Milan out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
25' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
23' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Davide Calabria with a fine lofted pass.
20' The resulting corner from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
19' The ball is crossed into the box and Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) reacts quickest to send a shot flying low towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye gets a glove on it to thwart him.
17' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
16' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
15' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
13' AC Milan take a short corner kick.
11' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
10' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
8' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Fabio Maresca interrupts the game.
5' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
3' A raking crossfield pass from Yacine Adli (AC Milan) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Fabio Maresca got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
